Package org.praxisplatform.uischema.bulk

Annotation Interface BulkResourceOperations

@Documented @Retention(RUNTIME) @Target(TYPE) public @interface BulkResourceOperations
Declares the five shared HTTP operation identities used by the bulk proposal and execution lifecycle for one @ApiResource controller.

The annotation supplies identities only. Real Spring MVC handler methods must carry one BulkResourceOperation role each; the binding is accepted only when those handlers map unambiguously to the declared resource and HTTP methods. It does not create routes or make a bulk action executable.
